Use link() for inline hyperlinks, link_button() for prominent call-to-action links, and page_link() to jump to another @aiui.page route without a full browser reload. Component Parameter Description link text, href, external Standard link (external=True opens in a new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer"). link_button label, href, variant, external Button-styled link (primary, secondary, outline, ghost). page_link page_id, label, variant, params Client-side SPA navigation to another registered page with optional URL query params.
